records.quote: is called a polynomial of degree n.
records.claim: The function f: R → R where f(x) = a_0 + a_1 x + a_2 x^2 + ... + a_n x^n, where a_0, a_1, a_2, ... a_n ∈ R, n ∈ N, a_n ≠ 0, is called a polynomial of degree n.

records.quote: the degree of the polynomial is the highest power
records.claim: The degree of the polynomial is the highest power of the variable in the function rule.

records.quote: The function f :R → R where f(x) = a x² + b x + c
records.claim: The function f: R → R where f(x) = ax² + bx + c, a, b, c real numbers, a ≠ 0, is called a quadratic function and it is a function of second degree.

records.quote: Represent graphically the quadratic function f, where f (x) = x²
records.stem: Represent graphically the quadratic function f, where $f(x)=x^2$, $x\in R$ consider $x\in[-3,3]$
solution: Identify some of the ordered pairs (x, f(x)) which belong to the function f where x ∈ R and that the interval is [-3, 3] gives some possible values the variable x.
Put these ordered pairs in a table as follows (table).
Identify in the cartesian plane the points which represent these ordered pairs, then draw a curve passing through these points.

records.quote: Notice that:
records.text: Notice that:

records.quote: The curve of the function f is symmetrical about the y-axis
records.claim: The curve of the function f is symmetrical about the y-axis and the equation of the symmetrical axis is x = 0.

records.quote: The coordinate of the vertex of the curve is (0, 0)
records.claim: The vertex of the curve is (0, 0), and the minimum value of the function = 0.

records.quote: Generylly:
records.text: Generylly:

records.quote: The function f(x) = ax² + bx + c, where a,b,c are real numbers
records.text: The function f(x) = ax² + bx + c, where a,b,c are real numbers, a ≠ 0 has the following properties:

records.quote: The coordinates of the vertex of the curve =
records.claim: The vertex of the curve has coordinates (-b/2a, f(-b/2a)).

records.quote: The curve of the function is open upwards U when the coefficient
records.claim: The curve opens upwards when the coefficient of x² is positive (a > 0); the function then has a minimum value equal to f(-b/2a).

records.quote: The curve of the function is open downward ∩ when the cofficient
records.claim: The curve opens downward when the coefficient of x² is negative (a < 0); the function then has a maximum value equal to f(-b/2a).

records.quote: The curve of the function is symmetric about the vertical line
records.claim: The curve is symmetric about the vertical line through the vertex, with equation X = -b/2a; this line is called the axis of symmetry of the function.

2. The coordinate of the vertex of the curve is $(0, 0)$ and the maximum value of the function $= 0$

objectives.label: Identify polynomial functions and find their degree
objectives.description: Decide whether a function rule is a polynomial and state its degree as the highest power of the variable.

objectives.label: Find the value of a polynomial function at a given number
objectives.description: Substitute a given real number into the function rule to find its image.

objectives.label: Represent linear and constant functions graphically
objectives.description: Recognise a linear or constant function and draw its straight-line graph from a table of ordered pairs, checking with a third point.

objectives.label: Represent a quadratic function graphically
objectives.description: Recognise a quadratic function and draw its parabola from a table of values on a given interval.

objectives.label: Find the vertex, axis of symmetry and maximum or minimum of a quadratic curve
objectives.description: Use the coefficients a, b, c to state the direction of opening, vertex, axis of symmetry and the minimum or maximum value.
